rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice when something moves smoothly across a surface by itself.

example.english: The marble can slide across the tabletop by itself.
example.traditional: 粒波子自己沿住枱面滑過去。
example.jyutping: lap1 bo1 zi2 zi6 gei2 jyun4 zyu6 toi2 min6 waat6 gwo3 heoi3

rows.jyutping: teoi1 zyu6 A waat6 gwo3 heoi3
rows.note: Use this when someone pushes an object so that it slides continuously along a surface.

example.english: I slide the cardboard box across the floor by pushing it.
example.traditional: 我推住個紙箱沿住地板滑過去。
example.jyutping: ngo5 teoi1 zyu6 go3 zi2 soeng1 jyun4 zyu6 dei6 baan2 waat6 gwo3 heoi3

rows.note: Use this as the standard noun for playground equipment; it is unrelated to the image and motion senses.

example.english: The children are queuing up to play on the slide at the park.
example.traditional: 小朋友喺公園排隊玩滑梯。
example.jyutping: siu2 pang4 jau5 hai2 gung1 jyun4 paai4 deoi6 waan2 waat6 tai1

rows.note: Use this when a person, vehicle, or other object loses traction and slides unintentionally.

example.english: The road is slippery, so be careful or you might slide and hurt yourself.
example.traditional: 條路好跣，小心一陣會跣親。
example.jyutping: tiu4 lou6 hou2 sin2 siu2 sam1 jat1 zan6 wui5 sin2 can1

rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose term for one page of a PowerPoint or other computer presentation.

example.english: Do we need to add a picture to this slide?
example.traditional: 呢張投影片要唔要加張相？
example.jyutping: ni1 zoeng1 tau4 jing2 pin2 jiu3 m4 jiu3 gaa1 zoeng1 soeng2

rows.note: Use this for a transparent photographic or film slide intended for projection, not for a computer presentation page.

example.english: We projected the slide onto a white screen.
example.traditional: 我哋將嗰張幻燈片投射到白幕上。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 zoeng1 go2 zoeng1 waan6 dang1 pin2 tau4 se6 dou3 baak6 mok6 soeng6

rows.note: Use this for the motion or activity of gliding smoothly, especially on ice or another surface.

example.english: It feels great to slide on the ice.
example.jyutping: hai2 bing1 min6 soeng6 waat6 hang4 hou2 syu1 fuk6

rows.note: Use this when something is quietly slipped or tucked into a place, including an unobtrusive insertion into text.

example.english: I quietly slide an extra sentence into the article while nobody is paying attention.
example.traditional: 我趁冇人留意，將一句補充攝入去篇文度。
example.jyutping: ngo5 can3 mou5 jan4 lau4 ji3 zoeng1 jat1 geoi3 bou2 cung1 sip3 jap6 heoi3 pin1 man4 dou6
